## Change
What changes for users, and why?

## Validation
- [ ] Windows build and helper tests pass.
- [ ] Interactive behaviour tested on Windows, or clearly marked not tested.
- [ ] Settings and existing X-Mouse commands remain compatible.
- [ ] No private screenshots, local paths, tokens or user configuration included.

## Risk / rollback
Mention focus, display, startup, installer and update-path effects. No forced foreground-lock bypasses or process termination.
